name: The Bean & Barley
short_description: Berridale's main all-day cafe, open 7 days with breakfast, brunch, and lunch - charming rustic space with gluten-free options.
long_description: The Bean & Barley is the best-reviewed cafe in Berridale (4.4 Google, 4.0 Tripadvisor) and the practical go-to for breakfast before heading to the slopes. Signature dishes include bacon and eggs, egg rolls, bacon rolls, cheesecake, and mud cake. The cafe has an airy, rustic ambience with outdoor seating, highchairs for kids, and accepts credit cards. Opens at 6:30-7am daily, closes at 2pm - meaning it's not an après-ski option.

name: Berridale Inn
short_description: The town pub - Australian country bar with a restaurant serving Asian-influenced dishes, open fireplace, TAB, and beer garden.
long_description: The Berridale Inn is the town's main pub and social hub. The restaurant serves Australian and Asian-influenced food (including pub meals from a $10 budget menu and a full dinner menu). The public bar has darts, Keno, TAB, and big-screen TVs; the lounge bar is family-friendly with a pool table and beer garden. Reviews note comfortable warm ambience and friendly service. Important caveat: the pub posted a Facebook notice of temporary closure due to electrical issues in late 2024 - check current operating status before visiting.

name: Meet You Halfway
short_description: Beloved vintage caravan coffee stop on Kosciuszko Road with community creative space, art gallery, and excellent espresso.
long_description: Meet You Halfway is a small but beloved Berridale institution - a vintage caravan coffee van on the Kosciuszko Road highway strip, now expanded with an adjoining dine-in creative space and art gallery. Run by Fen and Jase, the van is known for outstanding coffee (frequently called the best between Cooma and Jindabyne), Reuben toasties, and warm community atmosphere. Pet-friendly outdoor area. Opens early, making it ideal pre-ski. Closes in the afternoon - not an après option.

name: Out of Bounds Berridale Pizza
short_description: Wood-fired pizza van run by a local legend - fresh pizzas Friday-Saturday from 5pm, heat-to-eat range available daily from noon.
long_description: Out of Bounds is a wood-fired pizza van run by Anthony Green, a former skier who became Berridale's 2023 NSW Local Business of the Year. The dough is slow-fermented over days; toppings are locally sourced. The van offers two formats: fresh hot pizzas on Friday and Saturday from 5pm (phone orders from 5pm on 0412 867 751), and a heat-to-eat range of vacuum-sealed, oven-cooked pizzas available daily from noon for reheating at your accommodation - practical for groups staying in self-contained properties. Located at 20 Boundary Street per one source; van-based so may move.

name: Snowy Vineyard & Microbrewery (Dalgety Brewing Co)
short_description: Iconic winery and microbrewery on the Snowy River - nine craft beers on tap, estate wines, share platters, and outdoor dining.
long_description: The Snowy Vineyard & Microbrewery (now rebranded as Dalgety Brewing Co) is a 1980s tourism landmark located 18 km from Berridale on 255 Werralong Road, Dalgety. Nine craft beers on tap including IPA, stout, and hefeweizen, plus the estate's own wines (shiraz, bubbly, ciders). The outdoor areas include Snowy River frontage, outdoor games, and farm animals. Food covers brunch, lunch, and share platters (antipasto, cheese/meat boards, sweet potato fries, wedges, chicken tacos). Open Wed-Sun. Phone: +61 1300 766 608. Note: this is ~18 km from central Berridale but is listed under Berridale 2628 in tourism directories.

name: The Little Grocer / Shut The Gate Cellar Door
short_description: Gourmet providore, bottle shop, and cellar door wine bar combined - artisan cheeses, sourdough, oysters, craft beer, and local wines.
long_description: The Little Grocer Berridale is a gourmand's destination in a small town. It combines Shut The Gate's cellar door tasting room (cool-climate Tumbarumba and Hilltops wines), a premium providore stocked with artisan cheeses, charcuterie, pâté, fresh local sourdoughs, and Merimbula Lake oysters, plus craft beers and spirits. Build-your-own picnic platters can be enjoyed in the Secret Garden. Fresh produce arrives weekly. Also acts as Berridale's best bottle shop. Open Mon-Sat 10am-6pm, Sun 10am-5pm.

name: Berridale Thai Restaurant
short_description: Thai restaurant at 74 Jindabyne Road - newly listed, no reviews yet.
long_description: Berridale Thai Restaurant is listed at 74 Jindabyne Road (same building as the Berridale LPO/Post Office). It appears to be a recent addition to the Berridale dining scene with no Tripadvisor reviews yet and no posted hours. Phone contact available. Inclusion is based on verified Tripadvisor listing with confirmed address and phone; details should be treated with caution until the business is more established.

name: SnowGate Restaurant
short_description: Family restaurant inside the Snowgate Motel serving international cuisine for breakfast and dinner - open to non-guests.
long_description: The SnowGate Restaurant is the on-site dining option at Snowgate Motel on Southern Cross Drive. It serves an international menu for breakfast and dinner and is one of the few Berridale options with evening meals available, making it relevant for après-ski dining. Open to non-motel guests. The bar is also accessible. Given the motel's ski-season focus, hours are most reliable during the June-September season.
address: Lot 3 Southern Cross Drive, Berridale NSW 2628

name: Southern Cross Motor Inn Restaurant
short_description: 100-seat restaurant inside the Southern Cross Motor Inn with bar and open fireplace - open to the public.
long_description: The Southern Cross Motor Inn's 100-seat restaurant is one of the larger dining spaces in Berridale, serving pub-style meals with a bar/lounge and open fireplace. Open to the public, not just motel guests. Practical for groups or families wanting a sit-down dinner after skiing. The bar and fire make it a viable après-ski option in the ski season. No separate menu or hours published online - contact the motel directly.

name: The 19th Hole Berridale
short_description: Cafe at the Coolamatong Golf Club just outside Berridale - coffee and light meals for golfers and passers-by.
long_description: The 19th Hole Berridale is the cafe at Coolamatong Snowy Mountains Country Club (golf club), located just outside central Berridale on the road to Jindabyne. It is listed on Tripadvisor with no reviews as yet. Based on the pattern of Australian club cafes, it likely serves coffee, sandwiches, and basic meals. Included for completeness given limited Berridale food options, but treat hours and offerings as unverified.

name: IGA Berridale
short_description: The town's main supermarket on Jindabyne Road - essential for self-catering ski groups stocking up before heading to the mountain.
long_description: The IGA on Jindabyne Road is the primary grocery option in Berridale for self-catering ski groups. The store stocks standard supermarket essentials, pantry items, frozen food, and some fresh produce. For groups in self-contained properties - which cover a significant portion of Berridale's accommodation - this is a critical stop. Small-town IGA stores typically operate 7am-7pm Mon-Fri and reduced hours on weekends, though exact Berridale hours are not confirmed online. The IGA is also home to the Berridale LPO (post office) at Shop 6a, 74 Jindabyne Road.

name: Berridale Service Station
short_description: Fuel, convenience snacks, and hot food on the highway - the last servo before Jindabyne heading to the snowfields.
long_description: The service station on the Snowy Mountains Highway through Berridale is an essential practical stop for ski-bound travellers - fuelling up, grabbing snacks, hot drinks, and convenience food before hitting the mountain. The exact operator (United, Caltex, or independent) is unconfirmed online but a fuel station is confirmed operational in town. Provides: petrol, diesel, LP gas, convenience store snacks, hot food/pies (likely), coffee. Open daily, extended hours during ski season likely.

name: The Berridale Bakery
short_description: Local bakery in central Berridale - listed in nearby attraction data but hours and details unconfirmed.
long_description: The Berridale Bakery is listed as a nearby establishment in Tripadvisor's local data for Berridale (appearing as 'The Berridale Bakery' near Myack Street). No independent website or phone number has been confirmed. Given Berridale's small size and the existing Bean & Barley cafe, this may operate as a small-scale or part-time operation. Include with caution - verify hours and current operation locally before visiting.
